stem:
The diagram shows Krish pulling a closed drawer that was at rest and stretching a rubber band between his hands.

Which claims about these forces are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The pull can start the drawer moving from rest.
The stretch can change the rubber band's shape.
A force counts only when it starts an object moving from rest.
The rubber band's change of shape happens first, and then Krish's hands stretch it.

teacher.key_rationale: A force may start motion from rest and may change shape. Forces also act on objects already moving, so motion-from-rest is not the only case. The stretch causes the shape change; the shape change does not come first.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source force arrows as drawer pull and rubber-band stretch matching the stem.
